fact: WBBA states GAMTEL's National Broadband Network (420 km of fibre-optic links, around 31 central office sites) was deployed in 2019, extending the 2015 ECOWAN backbone and 947 km of legacy fibre in four rings, as a national backbone serving all key areas of the country.

WBBA states the national backbone (ECOWAN, NBN, legacy fibre) is accessible to private service providers, who use lit or dark fibre or buy capacity from GAMTEL, and that all MNOs and ISPs use GAMTEL's network; the document gives no date for this, so its published date 2024-05-13 is used.

GAMTEL signed a US$50 million PPP with SYSROAD SA HOLDING to upgrade, expand and modernise the national broadband infrastructure and internet backbone (40Gbps to 800Gbps, nationwide broadband expansion); document gives no signing date, so its published date is used and the stated work is chiefly a capacity upgrade.

The record says the World Broadband Association's case study states the National Broadband Network was deployed in 2019: 420 km of fibre-optic links and access networks around 31 central office sites, extending the 2015 ECOWAN backbone, owned and operated by GAMTEL; in July 2020 the minister said the network is earning.
